description: This Java source file defines the ThingSearchCommandAdapter class, which maps between the ThingSearchCommand signals and Adaptable representations within the protocol adapter framework. It handles signal mapping, type identification, and specifies relevant search actions and criteria.

classes.name: ThingSearchCommandAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class that maps ThingSearchCommand signals to and from Adaptable objects, facilitating integration within the protocol interaction layer.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ThingSearchCommandAdapter with the provided HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Maps a ThingSearchCommand signal to an Adaptable object, using the internal signalMapper.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type string for a given Adaptable, based on the search action.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the set of criteria (search-related) that this adapter handles.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns the set of actions this adapter supports (none in this case).

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates whether this adapter is intended for responses (false).

methods.name: getSearchActions
methods.description: Returns the set of search actions (subscribe, request, cancel) supported by this adapter.
